summary: The first execution completed (exit 0, tests_passed) but yielded no parsed observations: my three CA_EVENT objects had no event name, so all three were rejected as invalid_observation. I therefore treat that receipt as a harness format fault, not evidence, and revised the probe: each case now emits a named assurance_partition_setup event before the partition and a named assurance_verify_leader_result event after it, with the setup declared as the prerequisite admission for three comparisons (non-voter-only, voter-only, no-reachable-peer). The revision keeps the same measured fields and the experiment points at the previous one with a revision reason, so a fresh execution is requested. I also added the ReloadConfig Behaviour showing runtime reloads re-run ValidateConfig (so LeaderLeaseTimeout cannot exceed HeartbeatTimeout on a live node) and registered the resulting necessary gap about what legal condition could still overlap a successor election with an old leader that reports verify success. Unfinished: interpreting the new receipt and citing its indices; the defect account remains source-based and conditional.
